claims.statement: Counterexample: price wicks beyond a protected high, closes below it, then falls. Any external bullish CHoCH label is false; only sweep/probe evidence is defensible.
Counterexample: a 15m or 1H internal lower high breaks while the 4H/1D protected high remains intact. The child may be bullish recovery but parent structure cannot flip.

Ambiguous case: the visible window begins immediately before a body-close break and does not establish prior direction. Calling BOS or CHoCH is hindsight; classify an observed break with INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT.

Contested case: price slowly closes a few ticks beyond a protected level and holds. Geometry says accepted break, while impulse doctrine says low-quality or non-actionable. The constitution must represent both facts without collapsing them.
Counterexample: a visible three-candle gap has no qualifying opposite origin candle linked to the structural impulse. It is FVG-only and must not be annotated OB.

Counterexample: price decisively rejects the shallow qualified OB and never reaches the deeper block. Mechanical deeper-OB priority would hide valid reaction evidence; ranking must remain conditional.

recommendations: Blind cases must include wick probes, stale child breaks, marginal body closes, first-break ambiguity, FVG-only pockets, and shallow-versus-deep OB reactions.
Score object identity separately from narrative relationship correctness.
unresolved_conflicts: How much body penetration establishes acceptance rather than marginal noise.
How to rank shallow reaction evidence against deeper origin quality without hindsight.

claims.statement: Accept for pilot: confirmed structural breaks require body-close acceptance beyond the exact broken swing/protected extreme; wick-only penetration is probe/sweep evidence.
Accept for pilot: child/internal structure may describe timing or recovery but cannot flip parent external structure without a confirmed parent protected-point break.
Accept for pilot: every BOS/CHoCH/protected-point claim must name the exact structural object, confirmation candle, scope, and causal relationship.
Accept for pilot: insufficient left context, unresolved prior direction, unconfirmed protected point, or contradictory hierarchy requires explicit uncertainty rather than forced classification.
Accept for pilot: FVG, OB, breaker, and supply/demand are distinct object kinds; confluence does not permit relabeling one as another.

Keep contested: body close may establish geometric break existence while displacement grades quality/actionability, but the source set does not yet justify one universal threshold or whether weak breaks should retain BOS/CHoCH labels.
Keep contested: deeper origin OBs may deserve contextual priority and shallow zones may be inducement, but nearest-versus-deeper ranking is not universal and must survive blind cases.
Reject: AI agreement alone is sufficient to create human gold or modify runtime doctrine. AI consensus is a high-value research proposal that remains certification-pending.

recommendations: Build blind positive, negative, and ambiguous cases for the five accepted pilot rules before changing detector semantics.
Keep displacement and deeper-OB priority as explicit competing hypotheses in the benchmark.
Use AI consensus for routine operation and escalation, with later human certification only for constitution promotion.
unresolved_conflicts: Displacement as existence gate versus quality/actionability attribute.
Objective protected-point selection when the impulse origin is a candle cluster.
Contextual ranking of shallow reaction POI versus deeper origin OB.

claims.statement: Confirmed BOS and external CHoCH require a candle-body close beyond the exact broken swing or protected point; wick-only penetration is not a confirmed structural break.
Internal structure is lower-order timing evidence and cannot independently reverse parent external structure.
A protected point must be linked to the origin swing of a move that produced a qualified structural break; an arbitrary recent high or low is insufficient.

The source set conflicts on displacement: one manual treats it as a quality attribute for BOS/CHoCH existence, while house doctrine and consensus research sometimes make it mandatory for a valid or actionable break.
An FVG is an imbalance and must not be relabeled as an order block; POI kind and lifecycle must remain explicit.
A shallow POI may be inducement in front of a deeper origin OB, but automatic deeper-OB priority is a project hypothesis that still requires case evidence and cannot be universal doctrine.
Insufficient left context or unclear hierarchy requires explicit abstention rather than forced BOS/CHoCH classification.

recommendations: Separate structural existence from structural quality/actionability in the constitution.
Require exact broken-object IDs and confirmation-candle IDs for every structural event.
Keep deeper-OB preference contested until independent cases support it.
unresolved_conflicts: Whether displacement is required for the existence of BOS/CHoCH or only for quality/actionability.
Whether deeper origin OB priority should be a default ranking rule or only a contextual hypothesis.

claims.statement: Pilot definition: a break object requires scope, direction, broken_object_id, broken_price, confirmation_candle_id, and a body close beyond the broken wick extreme. Wick-only contact creates a probe/sweep candidate.

Pilot definition: external CHoCH is the first opposing body-close break of the current parent protected point. An opposing internal break remains recovery/pullback evidence unless the parent point is broken.
Pilot definition: BOS is a same-direction continuation break after structural direction is established; if prior direction is unresolved, classify the break event without forcing BOS versus CHoCH.

Pilot split: body-close geometry determines break existence; displacement is recorded separately as quality. Trade/action promotion may require displacement, but perception must not erase a geometric break solely for weak impulse until adjudicated evidence resolves the conflict.
Pilot definition: OB, FVG, breaker, and generic supply/demand remain different object kinds with separate origin evidence and lifecycle. Overlap may create confluence but not identity.
Pilot abstention: missing parent direction, unconfirmed protected point, insufficient left context, contradictory parent/child evidence, or ungrounded POI requires UNCLEAR or REVIEW_REQUIRED.

recommendations: Model event existence and event quality as separate fields.
Require causal links from protected point to qualified break.
Do not give pilot definitions runtime authority before blind evaluation.
unresolved_conflicts: Displacement threshold and whether it changes object existence.
Objective rule for selecting among multiple origin candles or candle clusters.
